email_subject: Application - Online Marketing Manager at MultipleChat
email_body:
Dear MultipleChat team,

I'm applying for the Online Marketing Manager role. Your focus on driving user acquisition for an AI product through Google Ads, funnels, and influencer collaborations aligns closely with my experience.

In my current roles, I manage Google Ads campaigns, optimize conversion funnels, and use analytics to improve ROI. I'm eager to bring my skills in paid ads, funnel optimization, and influencer partnerships to MultipleChat and help scale your growth. I've attached my CV and would welcome the chance to discuss how I can contribute.

cover_letter:
Dear Hiring Team,

I am writing to express my interest in the Online Marketing Manager position at MultipleChat. With a strong background in digital marketing, particularly in Google Ads, SaaS funnels, and conversion optimization, I am excited about the opportunity to contribute to your innovative AI product.

In my current role as a Junior Digital Marketer at Episto, I manage Google Ads campaigns, optimize landing pages, and analyze marketing data to improve conversion rates. I have hands-on experience with Google Analytics, Tag Manager, and marketing automation tools, and I regularly use these to track performance and generate actionable insights. Additionally, I have worked on SaaS and tech platforms, developing and executing growth strategies that align with product features.

My freelance work has further honed my skills in influencer collaborations and content marketing. I have successfully built and managed influencer partnerships in the AI and tech space, driving traffic and product adoption. For example, I optimized mirook.com using JSON-LD schema and llms.txt, which measurably improved search visibility and engagement. I also have experience with conversion funnel optimization across landing pages and marketing campaigns, ensuring a seamless user journey from click to conversion.

I am particularly drawn to MultipleChat's remote work environment and the opportunity to work with a fast-growing technology platform. I am confident that my analytical mindset, strong communication skills, and ability to scale acquisition channels will make a significant impact on your team.

Thank you for considering my application. I look forward to the possibility of discussing how my experience aligns with your needs.

Sincerely,
Baver Ok
